scripts.build: pnpm --filter @braindog/skin theme && pnpm run build:variants && vite build
scripts.//build:variants: BEFORE the main build, and that order is load-bearing: `.svelte-kit/output/client` is shared between builds and `bundle` reads its manifest from there, so building a variant LAST left the gate measuring the variant’s chunks against the shipped build’s `index.html` — and a variant build refreshed the mtime the staleness guard reads, laundering a stale `build/` past the check whose own comment says it exists because 116 bytes got three commits past it. The other record. A screen that branches on a fact about the record has a half the shipped seed cannot draw — the Cloud sentences shipped once and rendered nowhere — so the browser gates measure a second build. Four seconds, and it is what makes `dead-copy` counting a key inside a dead `{#if}` survivable.
scripts.build:variants: node -e "for (const v of ['cloud','quiet','busy']) { process.env.BRAINDOG_VARIANT=v; require('child_process').execSync('npx vite build',{stdio:'inherit'}); }"
